note: Budgets of the Meta Quest build. Read by scripts/godot/check_budgets.py (sections apk, tree) and godot/tools/measure_budgets.gd (section scene). Kept outside godot/ so the file does not ship in the APK. A limit is changed only in the same PR as docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md, with the reason.

total_bytes.why: 128 MiB: engine and runtime are ~89.6 MB and fixed; content may grow ~4x from today before the gate trips; about 13% of the Meta Store limit of 1 GB

native_libs_bytes.why: 84 MiB: four .so of Godot 4.7.1 debug + vendors 5.1.0 are 83,393,888 B; a second ABI or a new native plugin trips it

dex_bytes.why: 8 MiB: classes*.dex are 6,089,552 B; only a new Java/Kotlin plugin makes them grow

assets_bytes.why: 32 MiB of game content (assets/, uncompressed): about 3x the 11.56 MB of the current branch

largest_asset_bytes.why: 1 MiB per file: one JSON book of 0.70 MB took 7.9 MB of heap to parse; a larger single file is a frame hitch

content_bytes.why: 32 MiB of source in godot/art, godot/models, godot/data; the same ceiling as assets_bytes

largest_resource_bytes.why: same as apk.largest_asset_bytes, checked on the source before the build

model_triangles.why: CLAUDE.md TABOO 0.32 p.4: a proxy is at most 5,000 triangles

models/rov/mangustik.glb.why: docs/HLD_MANGUSTIK_COCKPIT_2026-09-30.md M2 and scripts/meta3d/mangustik_rov.py MAX_TRIANGLES = 20000 (whole vehicle). Conflicts with TABOO 0.32 p.4; open blocker for the operator in docs/APK_REQUIREMENTS.md

draw_calls_main_view.why: Quest 2 floor (< 100) because export_presets.cfg has quest_2_support=true; Quest 3 alone would allow < 200

primitives_two_eyes_est.why: Quest 2 floor (< 750K triangles per frame); estimate = 2 x main-view primitives + all SubViewports

static_memory_delta_bytes.why: 64 MiB of CPU heap over the engine baseline per scene: about 2.4x the worst scene (hub, +26.8 MB)

texture_memory_over_empty_bytes.why: 32 MiB of texture memory above an empty 3D scene at the same size and MSAA (content, fonts, SubViewports)

subviewport_bytes.why: 4 MiB of SubViewport render targets; measured 8 B/px on the host

script_ms_mean_host.why: a quarter of the 72 Hz frame (13.89 ms) for the scene's own _process on the CI host; Quest core speed is unknown

script_ms_max_host.why: half of the 72 Hz frame on the CI host

audio_generators.why: at most two synths fed by the CPU per scene; dive and witness have one each (dive_audio.gd, witness.gd)

device.why: measured only on the headset (OVR Metrics Tool, dumpsys meminfo); 2 GiB PSS is under half of the Quest 2 limit of 4.4 GiB

synth_ms_per_second_host.why: 5% of one CI-host core per second of audio; DiveSynth measured 22.6-24.3 ms, WitnessAudio 8.9-11.2 ms

pcm_clips_bytes.why: 16 MiB of float32 clips in RAM; the witness bells take 8,492,024 B on a Sunday and on Pascha

audio.checked_by: runtime measurement by the revisor (not automated)
